experiment.mechanism: usage-weighted college stuff+ (pitch_count weights, same-season (pitcher_id, year) join, non-null rows only) as an additional covariate in the pitcher college -> Single-A K% translation; matched-pairs LOO, incumbent shrinkage convention (slope * n/(n+SLOPE_SHRINK_K), K=20)
experiment.flag: EEPHUS_COL_XRV (default OFF; OFF path byte-identical, verified)

K1.bar: LOO K% MAE (augmented) < LOO K% MAE (stat-line-only), identical covered pairs, strict

K2.bar: bootstrap lo95 of per-pair improvement > 0 (2000 reps, seed 20260723, pair resampling)

fitted_on_all_covered_pairs.production_pit_k_context: production pit_k is fit on ALL matched pairs (n=257); the gate subset refit is the apples-to-apples baseline

loss_ledger.story: The covariate did not clear the frozen bars on the identical covered-pair set (K1 improvement -0.0242, K2 lo95 -0.0556). College stuff+ describes pitch quality, but on this sample it does not add K%-translation signal beyond the college K% line itself. Mechanism stays default-OFF behind EEPHUS_COL_XRV.
loss_ledger.keep_alive: Re-gate at next draft-class resolution (2025/2026 tracked classes reaching first pro A/A+ exposure).
